Name: Invite Code Webhook
Author: Gr33nBug
Description:
[size=6]Multiplayer Invite Webhook for Stardew Valley[/size]

[size=3]A [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] mod that automatically sends your [b]Stardew Valley multiplayer invite code[/b] to a [b]Discord webhook[/b] when you load a save. The message can be updated or marked as expired after a customizable period of time.[/size]

[size=5]Features
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Sends multiplayer invite code to Discord on save load.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Automatically updates the Discord message if the invite changes.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Optionally marks the message as expired after a configurable number of minutes.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Remembers the message ID so it can update or expire the correct message.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Fully customizable message text, color, thumbnail, and timing via config.json[/size]
[/list][size=5]Installation[/size][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI for Stardew Valley.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game once to generate a default config.json if you don't have one already.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open config.json with a text editor like notepad and configure the file with your discord webhook url and the other parameters to your liking.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5]Configuration
[/size][size=3]The configuration file config.json is created in the mod folder after first launch. You can edit it to customize behavior and appearance.[/size][size=5]
[/size][code]﻿{
"WebhookUrl": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/your-webhook-id",
"InviteTitle": "Multiplayer Invite Code",
"InviteDescription": "Join the game with code: **{inviteCode}**",
"InviteColor": 3447003,
"InviteFooter": "Invite Code is valid while the game is open",
"ExpiredTitle": "Invite Expired",
"ExpiredDescription": "The multiplayer invite code is no longer valid.",
"ExpiredColor": 15158332,
"ExpiredFooter": "Thanks for playing!",
"ImageUrl": "https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/b/bc/Krobus_Happy.png",
"ExpirationMinutes": 5
}
[/code]
